There's a concept called 'radical acceptance'. You can google it. It means to accept what is, even if you don't like it, you at least recognize this is the way things really are in your life. You then focus your energies on determining how to deal with reality, rather than griping about reality.

The reality is Reddit is not what it was. You are not going to change it back. The shareholders are not interested in Victoria, or the classic Admins who worked there for years, or any intangibles about Reddit, the things that made you value it, or a host of users who basically use their site for free. The shareholders, like any shareholders, want profit. Pao works for them, not you. She is doing exactly what they want. She is not the problem, in fact the shareholders do not view anything she is doing as a problem. The shareholders want Reddit to morph into something that gives them a return. A big return. So yes, what happens on the site will be tightly moderated and managed, sort of like a more complicated version of Buzzfeed or something along those lines. An infotainment site, full of harmless and entertaining fluff. It won't be fair, or honest, or open, or democratic - at least, not the way that you would define those concepts. It's a company, and companies are devoted to profit, not estoteric notions of fair play. And any measure of fairness etc. will be organized around profitability. Reddit is supposed to be a business, not something that enhances your or my life - or the community, or the world.

Please consider taking my advice: just delete your Reddit accounts & try to go cold turkey on visiting Reddit, and stay on Voat. Radically accept that Reddit is gone, finished, over. If you can do this, I think you'll be happier. And others on Voat will be happier, if we all try to build up Voat.

While I appreciate the intentions of the Tutanota team, unfortunately server-served web apps cannot be relied upon for security. The reason is because the web server can choose to serve a backdoored version of the JS files at any time -- to only select users, at select times. They only need to serve a backdoored version once to permanently grab your keys and decrypt all your emails, past, present, and future.

Tutanota cannot be relied upon for security. Any web app cannot be relied upon for security. You can only get that from downloadable apps.
